name: Model Router
description: Routes OpenClaw subagent spawns to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed sessions_spawn call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the spawn's one-line label, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its gateway setting allows, each with its own key. The spawn of the requesting agent itself sends that agent's description when it has one and a fixed text when it has none. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings. The scope setting picks the spawns: core routes the spawn of the requesting agent itself; extended also routes the spawns of other agents that set no model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process OpenClaw starts.

provider.label: Scoring provider
provider.help: Whose model scores each task. typesafe: Jev from TypeSafe, the model the plugin's questions are fitted to.

gateway.label: OpenRouter gateway
gateway.help: How OpenRouter is used to reach the provider. direct: the provider's own API only. auto: the provider's own API, then OpenRouter if it fails. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then the provider's own API if it fails. openrouter: OpenRouter only. With auto or openrouter-first and both keys set, one task may reach both companies.

scope.label: Routing scope
scope.help: Which spawns are routed. core: the spawn of the requesting agent itself. extended: also the spawns of other agents that set no model.

small_model.label: Small model
small_model.help: The model a spawn gets when Jev rates its task small, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

middle_model.label: Middle model
middle_model.help: The model a spawn gets when Jev rates its task middle, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

large_model.label: Large model
large_model.help: The model a spawn gets when Jev rates its task large, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

api_key.label: TypeSafe API key
api_key.help: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the gateway setting allows TypeSafe's own API. Unset: the plugin reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

openrouter_api_key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.help: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the gateway setting allows OpenRouter. Unset: the plugin reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment.
